home.title: Map repositories, inspect releases, and extract patches.
home.description: Fast browser-native tools for public GitHub repositories, with optional token support for higher API limits.
home.mapperDescription: Generate ASCII directory trees or plain path lists from any public repository.
home.releasesDescription: Visualize download counts and asset performance for GitHub releases.
home.leaderboardDescription: Meet leading GitHub developers and instantly find a username's local rank.
home.patchDescription: Extract raw .patch files from GitHub commit URLs for git apply.

mapper.truncated: Repo is massive, output was truncated by the GitHub API.

errors.tokenRejected: GitHub rejected the access token. Check that it is valid and has not expired.
errors.accessDenied: GitHub denied access. Check the token's repository access, permissions, organization approval, and SSO authorization.
errors.privateRepositoryHint: {message}. If this is private, provide a token with access to this repository.
